from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialItemRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single financial item value extracted from one report."""
    report_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of financial report (e.g., '2022年第一季财务报告')")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The period this report covers")
    item_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the financial item, as written in the document")
    value_period: str | None = Field(description="Whether this value is period-end ('期末') or beginning of period ('年初')")
    date: str | None = Field(description="The date for this value (e.g., '2022年3月31日')")
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The numerical amount as written in the document")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency/unit as written (e.g., '元')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short excerpt anchoring this value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_item_records: list[FinancialItemRecord]
